mechanism: Both drugs increase serotonergic activity; sumatriptan is a 5-HT1B/1D agonist and isocarboxazid is an MAOI that inhibits serotonin metabolism, creating severe risk of serotonin syndrome.
action: Sumatriptan is contraindicated with MAOIs including isocarboxazid; discontinue MAOI for at least 14 days before initiating sumatriptan or use alternative migraine therapy.
